mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(record_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') AS time_slot, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN online_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS online_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN online_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS online_rate, AVG(cpu_usage) AS avg_cpu, AVG(memory_usage) AS avg_memory, AVG(temperature) AS avg_temperature FROM device_status_record WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND record_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(record_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00') ORDER BY time_slot

SELECT d.id AS device_id, d.device_no, d.device_name, d.online_status, d.status AS run_status, r.temperature, r.cpu_usage, r.memory_usage, r.record_time AS last_record_time FROM device_info d LEFT JOIN device_status_record r ON r.id = ( SELECT id FROM device_status_record WHERE device_id = d.id ORDER BY record_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE d.deleted = 0 ORDER BY d.id
